title: Generate the loomed rug
author: claude
summary: A script makes a seamless hand-loomed wool texture that the room uses.
what: We wrote three ways to generate a rug texture. The room uses the hand-loomed one.
why: A generated texture repeats seamlessly and its colour is under our control.
how:
- A heathered wool woven from a hessian pattern.
- A pile made from Carpet013.
- A hand-loomed seamless tile, 1 m wide at 2048 pixels. This is the one the room uses.

tech.name: Seamless tile
tech.plain: A small picture made to repeat across a big surface with no visible seams.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.
